text:
I understand you're frustrated, but I need to authenticate your identity before I can access any order information or provide tracking numbers. This is for your security and privacy protection.

Since you don't have an email address available and prefer not to provide your name and zip code, I'll need to transfer you to a human agent who may have additional ways to verify your identity.
zh:
我理解你很沮丧，但在我能够访问任何订单信息或提供追踪号之前，我需要验证你的身份。这是为了你的安全和隐私保护。

由于你没有电子邮件地址，并且不愿意提供你的名字和邮政编码，我需要将你转接给一个人类客服，他们可能有其他方法来验证你的身份。
